title: U.S. House · California's 28th District
area: The San Gabriel Valley in Los Angeles County, including Monterey Park, Alhambra, El Monte, and the Linda Vista area of Pasadena. District lines were redrawn for the 2026 election under California Proposition 50.

context.text: California redrew its congressional district lines for the 2026 election cycle after voters approved Proposition 50 on November 4, 2025, a mid-decade redistricting measure.
Incumbent Democrat Judy Chu, first elected in 2009, and Republican April Verlato, a former mayor of Arcadia, advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary.

summary.text: Judy Chu is the Democratic incumbent for California's 28th Congressional District, first elected in 2009. She previously served as a college professor and as mayor of Monterey Park, and serves on the House Committee on Ways and Means.

background.text: Born in Los Angeles, California. Earned a bachelor's degree from UCLA in 1974 and a Ph.D. from the California School of Professional Psychology in 1979.
Worked as a professor at Los Angeles City College and East Los Angeles College.
Served as mayor of Monterey Park, California, before her election to Congress.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Ways and Means (Health Subcommittee; Oversight Subcommittee; Work and Welfare Subcommittee) and the House Committee on the Budget in the 119th Congress (2025-2026).

candidates.name: April Verlato
candidates.currentRole: Former Mayor of Arcadia, California (mayor beginning 2020; Arcadia City Council member since 2016)

summary.text: April Verlato is the Republican nominee for California's 28th Congressional District. She is an attorney and businesswoman who served on the Arcadia City Council and as mayor of Arcadia.

background.text: Born and raised in Arcadia, California. Earned a bachelor's degree in political science from UCLA and a law degree from Southwestern School of Law.
Worked as a businesswoman and attorney; elected to the Arcadia City Council in 2016 and served as mayor beginning in 2020.

priorities.text: Campaign platform emphasizes fiscal responsibility, support for law enforcement, national security, border security, market-driven healthcare solutions, veterans' needs, and reducing the national debt.
Cites leading the revitalization of Downtown Arcadia as mayor, including work to attract small businesses and events to the area.
